raw_segments.text: Whale the whale, up helm, up helm, O all ye sweet powers of air now hug me close.
Let not starbuck die if die he must in a woman's fainting fit.
Up helm, I say ye fools the jaw the jaw, Is this the end of all my bursting prayers,
All my life-long fidelities, O Ahab, Ahab, lo, thy work.
Helmsman steady, nay nay, up helm again, He turns to meet us.
O, his unappeasable brow drives on towards one Whose duty tells him he cannot depart.
My God, stand by me now.
